rows.text:
Autonomous signal: you write down whatever you get (a word, sensation, impulse, objection, or silence), and you don’t treat it as proof. Deepener: none here, though being fully alert isn’t a lesser version. Handoff: have your adult self answer the question in whatever way is appropriate, and I’d rather that answer come through writing or doing something. Integration/exit: once you’ve reality tested the signal, do one small thing based on it. You just close the exercise there and carry on with your day, since you didn’t go into trance.
The personal accounts and the way I arrange this practice are my own, especially adaptations like the one I’m doing here where I am combining body-oriented work and hypnotic work.
